# Release Asset Packager — CWI Distributor Deliverable Gate

Given a track, release date, and asset attestations, this assembles the distributor deliverable bundle and **fails CLOSED** (red gate) on missing or conflicted ISRCs. A release can never ship past it without its identifier. Feeds the Release Timeline Automator's T-6wk checkpoint.

## Machine-readable endpoints
- /data/tracks.json — 52 catalog tracks, schema cwi.release-track/1.0 (title, artist, isrc, isrc_status; 46 verified, 2 conflicted, 4 missing). Snapshot of the 2026-09-19 catalog-index.
- /bundle.schema.json — JSON Schema for cwi.release-bundle/1.0
- /release-packager.js — zero-dep UMD bundle engine (browser + Node)
- /cli/build.js — Node CLI: `node cli/build.js <track-id> [--release-date YYYY-MM-DD] [--cover-attested] [--upc CODE]`

## Gate rules
- Hard (block the bundle): title present, artist present, ISRC present, ISRC status verified, ISRC format valid.
- Soft (WARN, never block): cover art attested, UPC supplied, T-6wk distributor freeze window.

## Truth labels
VERIFIED = checked against the catalog-index snapshot. USER-ATTESTED = packager self-declared (cover art). UNVERIFIED = everything else.

## Kill rule
Snapshot older than 60 days is flagged STALE; zero re-verified catalog-index syncs per 60 days → retire.
